sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Ill-Wisher is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Ah, it's you. Good. Your help will come in handy. Someone's been jamming my communications lately. I managed to work around the interference without tipping them off, but that's only half the job. Now we need to find the source and shut it down. I've already traced it to the coast line. A setup like that would require some serious antennas, probably satellite dishes. Find them and install signal jammers."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the first signal source on Shoreline
- Place a Signal jammer on the first signal source
- Locate the second signal source on Shoreline
- Place a Signal jammer on the second signal source

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"I checked the frequency. The interference really was coming from those towers. What I still can't figure out is why anyone would bother doing it..."

sections.heading: Initial Equipment
sections.text:
Unlocks purchase of Signal Jammer at Mechanic LL1.
| Item name | Amount | Notes |
| Signal Jammer | 2 | This item is placed at the antennas. When placed, the item is removed from the players' inventory. |

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Signal Jammer | 2 | Required | N/A | Can be purchased from Mechanic LL1. |
In this quest you have to locate two antennas on Shoreline and place a Signal Jammer on them.
